headline: Exhibition Stand Builders & Contractors in Dubai
lede: Exhibition stand contractors in Dubai — custom, double-deck, modular & shell scheme. In-house Ras Al Khor fabrication. Free quote for DWTC, Expo City & GCC shows.
services: Stands and stages we’re proud of
Exhibition services that stop the show
about: NS Events & Exhibitions is a full-service exhibition booth contractor and event production company headquartered in the UAE. We design, fabricate, install, and hire stands for brands across the GCC and India — custom builds, double-deck stands, pavilions, shell schemes, modular systems, and trade show displays.

We built our brand on creativity and expertise, and we want to share it with you. Our team of highly skilled professionals brings a wealth of knowledge and experience to the table, ensuring that we deliver exceptional results for our clients.
